title: Coefficient continuation from a cyclic quotient to a uniformizer quotient
statement: Let l be prime, Y any scheme, P=ProjectiveLine Y and W=diagonalSurface Y. Let E be a finite intermediate extension, pi in O_E, n natural and A any ordinary commutative ring with l^(n+1)=0 in A. Supply a Z_l Diagram d0, an integral O_E Diagram dE, a ScalarCompatibility toE along integralMap, and a quotient Diagram d with ScalarCompatibility scalar along quotientMap [def-sfb-diagonal-coefficient-scalars]. Supply finite realizations eP,eW, root-normalized UniformizerRootFrame lineW [def-diagonal-uniformizer-root-frame] and FiniteSourceComparison sourceComparison. The coefficient isomorphism in each finite realization identifies the constant A with the quotient ring object pulled to that scheme. Supply any CyclicCartierFrame p [def-diagonal-cyclic-cartier-frame]. Let phi:R=ULift(Z/l^(n+1))->A be cartierResidueAlgebra and eta,theta the maps on the ordinary constant on P and positive Tate line on W normalized on constant generators and pure root tensors as in GeoCartierScalarCompatibility [def-sfb-geo-cartier-interface]. Write cA=finiteRealizedClass of d.delta using the supplied endpoints. Then mk0(i_*eta) composed with restriction_phi(cA) equals p.reduce(d0.delta) composed with mk0(theta), as an Ext^2 equality over R. This is a coefficient comparison for an arbitrary initial arrow: neither completion, IsDiagonalLimit nor the assertion that d0.delta or p.reduce(d0.delta) is Cartier is assumed.

proof.text: Pull the actual coefficient maps Z_l->O_E->O_E/(pi)^(n+1) to W and P. The finite realization coefficient isomorphisms identify the target with constant A. Because hA kills l^(n+1), the sheafified quotient universal property factors these pulled-back maps through the cyclic quotient. The resulting map is the unital prime-power coefficient map fixed by the integer action.

Use derived scalar transitivity and the normalized adjunction units of the two ScalarCompatibility structures and the cyclic frame. The pure tensor formula identifies the supported source maps with i_*eta. IntegralRoots projections, FiniteRoots kernel inclusions and the two line normalizations identify the target map with theta. These arguments do not use a property of the initial arrow.

Apply the toE.delta and scalar.delta equations. Naturality of exact realization single and shift comparisons and cancellation of the endpoint isomorphisms give the coefficient square. Translate the resulting single-to-shifted-single equality by Ext.homEquiv.
